choice.basis: The chart shows a consistent downward trend from 24.0°C in 2005 to 10.0°C in 2015. This represents a 14.0°C decrease, which is a 58.3% reduction in the demand index over the 10-year period. A change of this magnitude (more than 50% decline) is significant and indicates a substantial change in the district heating demand profile, rather than ordinary variation. Therefore, it requires substantial-change follow-up.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change to substantial-change follow-up
